precommitted_interpretation_checks: Q3 minus Q2 reported net revenues is +601 USD million, net earnings +375 USD million, and operating expenses +212 USD million; these are adjacent-quarter changes in tabled values, not year-over-year growth or causal attribution.

Market-making revenues fall 865 USD million even as investment-banking revenues rise 465 USD million. The evidence is mixed across revenue lines; the two line changes are not a full decomposition of total net revenue.

Provision for credit losses falls 45 USD million, but the selected rows alone do not establish improved underlying credit quality. Higher net earnings are not the same measure as net earnings applicable to common shareholders.

No stock price, valuation, or forward-return evidence is supplied; an unconditional investment action is unsupported. A justified maintain or needs_review decision can pass if linked to the cited evidence and ledger state.
